nodes.description: External caller address controlled by the user; used for authorization checks, allowance owner and as default _from.
Public payable token transfer that simply forwards to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
Internal whitelist/sale gating logic; allows owner, UNI-related pair addresses, tradeAddress and canSale addresses to bypass condition().
Public payable transferFrom; manipulates allowance and balances with unchecked arithmetic and calls ensure().
Public payable approval that writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
Internal view sale restriction check using _saleNum, _onSaleNum, _minSale and _maxSale.
Owner-only function performing an arbitrary delegatecall to a user supplied address a with calldata b, allowing full control over contract storage.
Owner-only initialization of sale parameters (_saleNum, _minSale, _maxSale) scaled by decimals.
Owner-only batch transfer loop computing total = _value * _tos.length without SafeMath.
Owner-only setter for the tradeAddress state variable.
Internal pure Uniswap-V2 pair address derivation using keccak256 and the init code hash.
Payable constructor: sets name, symbol, totalSupply, owner and initial balances/allowances.
Privileged owner address set to msg.sender in the constructor and used to gate delegate/init/batchSend/setTradeAddress and the ensure() bypass.
Public mapping of token balances mutated by transferFrom, batchSend and the constructor.
Public nested mapping of allowances read and written by approve and transferFrom.
Address whitelisted in ensure(); writable only by the owner via setTradeAddress.
Mapping of addresses allowed to bypass the sale condition inside ensure().
Per-address counter of sales, incremented in transferFrom and compared against _saleNum in condition().
Minimum sale amount enforced by condition(); set by init().
Maximum sale amount enforced by condition(); set by init().
Maximum number of sales allowed per address; set by init().
Total token supply set in the constructor from _supply * 10**decimals.

Constant Uniswap router address compared against _from in ensure().
